lead.headline: Howard won at Davidson
lead.deck: The Bison rate 152nd, highest in the MEAC by more than 130 places. Morgan State is 4-1.
body: Hardwood Bricks now covers the Mid-Eastern Athletic Conference, eight schools from Dover, Princess Anne, Baltimore and Washington down through Norfolk to Durham and Orangeburg. Every game gets a preview, a recap, a line history and a spot in our ratings.
Howard (152nd) won 64-58 at Davidson, 94-83 at Alcorn State and beat Stetson 75-62. Its losses came at Yale and Penn.
Morgan State is 4-1. The Bears won 73-67 at Niagara and beat Loyola Maryland 63-61 in overtime on a neutral floor.
South Carolina State is 3-1, with wins at USC Upstate and Chicago State.
North Carolina Central is 0-4, including an 80-75 overtime loss at Longwood.

column.label: By the Numbers
column.title: Three numbers from the first two weeks
body: **1.** MEAC team in our national top 250: Howard. South Carolina State is next at 288th.
**103.** Morgan State's points against Cheyney, the league's high.
**2.** MEAC road wins over Division I teams by double digits: Howard at Alcorn State and South Carolina State at Chicago State.
